medium_bugs.impact: Dispatcher cannot update rate sheet via API (database update works, but response fails)
medium_bugs.details: The endpoint returns a dict with 'updated_at': _now() (datetime object) which needs to be serialized to ISO string before returning. Use serialize_doc() or convert datetime to .isoformat()

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix PUT /api/wrecker/rate-sheet endpoint: The endpoint returns 500 because it returns a dict with datetime object ('updated_at': _now()). Solution: Either use serialize_doc(doc) before returning, or convert datetime to ISO string: doc['updated_at'] = doc['updated_at'].isoformat(). The database update works correctly, only the response serialization fails.
